title: Finiteness of a finite type ring map descends along a directed colimit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(A_i)_{i\in I}$ a directed system of commutative rings (ring maps $A_i\to A_{i'}$ for $i\le i'$, compatible), with colimit $A=\varinjlim_iA_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $0\in I$, let $B_0$ and $C_0$ be commutative $A_0$-algebras and $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$ a homomorphism of $A_0$-algebras which is of finite type ($C_0$ is generated as a $B_0$-algebra, via $\varphi_0$, by finitely many elements). For $i\ge0$ regard $A_i$ as an $A_0$-algebra via the transition map, and $A$ via the coprojection, and put $B_i=A_i\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, $C_i=A_i\otimes_{A_0}C_0$, $\varphi_i=\mathrm{id}_{A_i}\otimes\varphi_0:B_i\to C_i$, and $B=A\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, $C=A\otimes_{A_0}C_0$, $\varphi=\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\varphi_0:B\to C$. If $\varphi$ is finite ($C$ is a finitely generated $B$-module via $\varphi$), then there is an $i\ge0$ such that $\varphi_i$ is finite ($C_i$ is a finitely generated $B_i$-module via $\varphi_i$) (Stacks Algebra, Lemma 07RG).

proof.text: Choose a Finset s of B₀-algebra generators of C₀ from φ₀.FiniteType.out, with the algebra structure induced by φ₀. For any A₀-algebra T, prove by Algebra.adjoin_induction that 1 tensor c lies in the algebra generated by the 1 tensor s. TensorProduct.induction_on then expresses every tensor as a sum of products of image scalars t tensor 1 with these elements, so the tensor generators generate T tensor C₀ over T tensor B₀.

Apply RingHom.Finite.to_isIntegral, the ring-map form of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-algebra-is-integral], to finiteness at the colimit. In particular each 1 tensor x for x in s is integral over the colimit base change of B₀.

Use [lem-weil-pbc-integral-tensor-generators-colimit-descent] to obtain one stage i ≥ i₀ where every tensor generator is integral. This lemma proves the original coefficient-lifting and eventual-zero steps using [lem-weil-pbc-directed-colimit-base-change-elementwise].

At that stage apply Algebra.finite_adjoin_of_finite_of_isIntegral, the Mathlib realization of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-of-integral-generators], to the finite image of s. Rewrite the adjoin to top by the tensor-generation argument, and transport Module.Finite from the top subalgebra to the entire tensor algebra with Subalgebra.topEquiv.toLinearMap and Module.Finite.of_surjective. This is precisely finiteness of the tensor-product map.
